# Domain Concepts & Glossary
<!-- docs.AI knowledge doc — auto-generated by speckit.init -->

## Workflow Terms

| Term | Definition |
|------|-----------|
| **Golden Path** | The full recommended workflow: grill-me → specify → clarify → plan → tasks → tdd → implement → pr-ready |
| **Spec** | Business requirements document with user stories and acceptance criteria (`spec.md`) |
| **Plan** | Technical design document covering data model, architecture decisions, and API contracts (`plan.md`) |
| **Tasks** | Dependency-ordered implementation units, each prefixed T001, T002… (`tasks.md`) |
| **Grill Me** | Design review phase — 8–10 critical questions asked before any plan is written; produces a Go/No-Go verdict |
| **Specify** | Produces the spec via interview + codebase exploration |
| **Clarify** | Removes ambiguity from the spec with at most 5 targeted questions |
| **TDD** | Test-driven development: write a failing test (RED), make it pass (GREEN), improve without breaking (REFACTOR) |
| **Implement** | Executes all tasks from `tasks.md` phase-by-phase with TDD integrated |
| **PR Ready** | Validates the branch against a checklist and generates a formatted pull request |

## Artifact Terms

| Term | Definition |
|------|-----------|
| **Tracer Bullet** | A vertical slice through all layers (DB → business logic → API → UI) implemented as one task |
| **User Story** | Format: "As a [role], I want [action] so that [value]" |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | Format: "Given [state], When [action], Then [outcome]" — maps to test cases |
| **Constitution** | Non-negotiable governance rules stored in `specs/memory/constitution.md`; gates design decisions |
| **Checklist** | Requirements quality validation artifact — "unit tests for English" |
| **Research** | Technical decision log (`research.md`): alternatives considered, ADRs |
| **Contract** | API specification or interface contract (`contracts/<name>.md`) |
| **Feature Index** | `specs/feature.json` — pointer to the currently active feature directory |

## Tracker Terms

| Term | Platform | Definition |
|------|---------|-----------|
| **PBI** | Azure DevOps | Product Backlog Item (= Story) |
| **Epic** | All | Top-level initiative grouping features |
| **Feature** | ADO, Jira | Business capability within an epic |
| **Story** | Jira, GitHub, Linear | User journey within a feature |
| **Task** | All | Implementation unit within a story |
| **Iteration** | ADO | Sprint pointer (path like `ProjectName\Sprint 1`) |
| **Cycle** | Linear | Sprint equivalent in Linear |

## Scoping Terms

| Term | Definition |
|------|-----------|
| **Global data** | Applies system-wide; no tenant filtering required |
| **Scoped data** | Per-tenant, per-user, or per-org; every query and mutation must include the scope filter |
| **Multi-tenancy** | Design assumption: all projects are assumed to be scoped unless explicitly stated otherwise |

## Testing Terms

| Term | Definition |
|------|-----------|
| **Red** | A failing test that describes the desired behavior before any implementation |
| **Green** | Minimal code that makes the red test pass |
| **Refactor** | Improving code structure without breaking any tests |
| **Cycle** | One iteration of the TDD loop (Red → Green → Refactor) |
| **Stack auto-detection** | The TDD skill inspects project files to pick the correct test framework automatically |

## Skill System Terms

| Term | Definition |
|------|-----------|
| **SKILL.md** | Self-contained skill definition file (YAML frontmatter + instruction body) |
| **Template resolution** | The 3-step lookup: project custom → prompt inline → repo default |
| **Session gate** | Check performed once per session (e.g., does `specs/.templates/` exist?) |
| **Bootstrap gate** | Check performed once per project (e.g., does `docs.AI/1_README.AI.md` exist?) |
